SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, p.code AS parent_code, p.name AS parent_name, c.code, c.name, c.sort_order, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_by, c.updated_by FROM in_app_message_category c LEFT JOIN in_app_message_category p ON c.parent_id = p.id
AND c.code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.code}, '%')
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT(#{query.name}, '%')
AND c.parent_id = #{query.parentId}
AND c.parent_id = 0
AND c.parent_id > 0
AND c.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
